description: Chinese-learning Quiz draft pack. Chinese is the learning language; optional English secondary text is shown only when English is selected as the translation language. All items require human linguistic and assessment QA before release.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个音节使用第一声？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè yīn jié shǐ yòng dì yī shēng
questions.prompt_translation: Which syllable uses the first tone?
questions.explanation_learning: 第一声保持高而平；“妈”读作 mā，声调是第一声。
questions.explanation_pinyin: dì yī shēng bǎo chí gāo ér píng; “mā” de shēng diào shì dì yī shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: The first tone stays high and level. 妈 is pronounced mā, with the first tone.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个汉字读作第三声的 mǎ？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè hàn zì dú zuò dì sān shēng de
questions.prompt_translation: Which character is pronounced mǎ, with the third tone?
questions.explanation_learning: “马”读作 mǎ，使用第三声；第三声的调号写在元音 a 上。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “mǎ” dú zuò mǎ, shǐ yòng dì sān shēng; dì sān shēng de diào hào xiě zài yuán yīn a shàng.
questions.explanation_translation: 马 is pronounced mǎ with the third tone; its tone mark is written over the vowel a.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪种说法最准确地描述第二声？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ zhǒng shuō fǎ zuì zhǔn què de miáo shù dì èr shēng
questions.prompt_translation: Which statement best describes the second tone?

options.translation_text: The voice starts high and falls.
options.pinyin: shēng yīn xiān gāo hòu dī.

options.translation_text: The voice rises from low to high.
options.pinyin: shēng yīn yóu dī xiàng gāo shàng shēng.

options.translation_text: The voice stays high and level.
options.pinyin: shēng yīn bǎo chí gāo ér píng.
shēng yīn kuài sù xià jiàng.

questions.explanation_learning: 第二声的音高从较低的位置向较高处上升，听起来像上扬的语调。
questions.explanation_pinyin: dì èr shēng de yīn gāo cóng jiào dī de wèi zhì xiàng jiào gāo de wèi zhì shàng shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: The second tone rises from a relatively low pitch to a higher pitch.

questions.prompt_learning: 汉语拼音的主要作用是什么？
questions.prompt_pinyin: hàn yǔ pīn yīn de zhǔ yào zuò yòng shì shén me
questions.prompt_translation: What is the main purpose of Hanyu Pinyin?

options.pinyin: biāo jì pǔ tōng huà de dú yīn.
biǎo shì hàn zì de bǐ huà shùn xù.
dài tì suǒ yǒu hàn zì.
biǎo shì jù zi de yǔ fǎ jié gòu.

questions.explanation_learning: 汉语拼音用字母和声调符号标记普通话读音，帮助学习者认读和学习发音。
questions.explanation_pinyin: hàn yǔ pīn yīn yòng zì mǔ hé shēng diào fú hào biāo jì pǔ tōng huà dú yīn, bāng zhù xué xí zhě rèn dú hé xué xí fā yīn.
questions.explanation_translation: Hanyu Pinyin uses letters and tone marks to represent Mandarin pronunciation and help learners read and practise sounds.

questions.prompt_learning: 在“妈妈”中，哪个音节通常读轻声？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài “mā ma” zhōng, nǎ ge yīn jié tōng cháng dú qīng shēng?
questions.prompt_translation: Which syllable in 妈妈 is normally pronounced with the neutral tone?

options.translation_text: Both syllables use the first tone.
options.pinyin: liǎng gè dōu shì dì yī shēng

options.translation_text: Both syllables use the fourth tone.
options.pinyin: liǎng gè dōu shì dì sì shēng

questions.explanation_learning: 在“妈妈”中，第二个“妈”通常读轻声 ma，发音较轻、较短，不标第一声。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zài “mā ma” zhōng, dì èr gè “ma” tōng cháng dú qīng shēng, fā yīn jiào qīng, jiào duǎn, bù biāo dì yī shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: In 妈妈, the second syllable is usually the neutral-tone ma, spoken lightly and briefly without a first-tone mark.

questions.prompt_learning: “你好”的标准拼音写法是什么？
questions.prompt_pinyin: “nǐ hǎo” de biāo zhǔn pīn yīn xiě fǎ shì shén me?
questions.prompt_translation: Which spelling is the standard written pinyin for 你好?

options.translation_text: Incorrect tone on the second syllable.
Incorrect tone on the first syllable.

questions.explanation_learning: 标准拼音书写保留“你”和“好”各自的本调，因此写作 nǐ hǎo；连读时第一个三声会发生变调。
questions.explanation_pinyin: biāo zhǔn pīn yīn shū xiě bǎ “nǐ” hé “hǎo” gè zì de běn lái shēng diào bǎo liú xià lái, suǒ yǐ xiě zuò nǐ hǎo; lián dú shí dì yī gè sān shēng huì biàn diào.
questions.explanation_translation: Standard written Pinyin keeps the underlying tones of 你 and 好, so it is written nǐ hǎo. In connected speech, the first third tone changes.

questions.prompt_learning: 关于第三声，哪种说法最准确？
questions.prompt_pinyin: guān yú dì sān shēng nǎ zhǒng shuō fǎ zuì zhǔn què
questions.prompt_translation: Which statement about the third tone is most accurate?

options.learning_text: 它总是完整地先降后升。
options.translation_text: It always fully falls and then rises.
options.pinyin: tā zǒng shì wán zhěng de xiān jiàng hòu shēng.

options.learning_text: 它在单独读或句末时常呈现先降后升。
options.translation_text: When spoken alone or at the end of a phrase, it often dips and rises.
options.pinyin: tā zài dān dú huò jù mò shí cháng chéng xiàn xiān jiàng hòu shēng.

options.learning_text: 它的音高始终保持不变。
options.translation_text: Its pitch always stays the same.
options.pinyin: tā de yīn gāo shǐ zhōng bǎo chí bù biàn.
tā zǒng shì kuài sù xià jiàng.

questions.explanation_learning: 第三声在单独读或位于词组末尾时，常呈现先降后升；在其他语流位置也可能只读半三声。
questions.explanation_pinyin: dì sān shēng zài dān dú huò wèi yú cí zǔ mò wěi shí, cháng chéng xiàn xiān jiàng hòu shēng; zài qí tā lián dú wèi zhì yě kě néng zhǐ dú bàn sān shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: When spoken alone or at the end of a phrase, the third tone often dips and rises. In other connected-speech positions, it may be a half-third tone.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“早上好”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì zǎo shàng hǎo
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “Good morning”?
questions.explanation_learning: “早上好”是早晨见面时常用的问候语。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zǎo shang hǎo” shì zǎo chén jiàn miàn shí cháng yòng de wèn hòu yǔ.
questions.explanation_translation: 早上好 is a common greeting used when meeting someone in the morning.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“谢谢”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì xiè xiè
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “Thank you”?
questions.explanation_learning: “谢谢”用来表达对他人的帮助、礼物或好意的感谢。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xiè xie” yòng lái biǎo dá duì tā rén de bāng zhù, lǐ wù huò hǎo yì de gǎn xiè.
questions.explanation_translation: 谢谢 expresses gratitude for someone's help, gift or kindness.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个短语可以礼貌地引出一个问题？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè duǎn yǔ kě yǐ lǐ mào de yǐn chū yī gè wèn tí
questions.prompt_translation: Which phrase politely introduces a question?
questions.explanation_learning: “请问”常放在问题前，用来礼貌地引起对方注意并提出询问。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “qǐng wèn” cháng fàng zài wèn tí qián, yòng lái lǐ mào de yǐn qǐ duì fāng zhù yì bìng tí chū xún wèn.
questions.explanation_translation: 请问 is commonly placed before a question to politely get someone's attention and make an enquiry.

questions.prompt_learning: 回应“谢谢”时，哪种说法最自然？
questions.prompt_pinyin: huí yìng “xiè xie” shí, nǎ zhǒng shuō fǎ zuì zì rán?
questions.prompt_translation: Which is a natural reply to 谢谢?
questions.explanation_learning: “不客气”常用于回应“谢谢”，表示对方不必特别客气。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bú kè qi” cháng yòng yú huí yìng “xiè xie”, biǎo shì duì fāng bù bì tè bié kè qi.
questions.explanation_translation: 不客气 is a natural response to 谢谢, meaning that the other person need not mention it.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“再见”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì zài jiàn
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “Goodbye”?
questions.explanation_learning: “再见”用于分别时，表达希望之后再次见面的意思。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zài jiàn” yòng yú fēn bié shí, biǎo dá xī wàng zhī hòu zài cì jiàn miàn de yì si.
questions.explanation_translation: 再见 is used when parting and conveys the idea of seeing the person again.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我叫李明”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ jiào lǐ míng
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “My name is Li Ming”?

options.pinyin: nǐ jiào shén me míng zi

questions.explanation_learning: “我叫李明”是介绍姓名的常见说法，意思是“我的名字是李明”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng” shì jiè shào xìng míng de cháng jiàn shuō fǎ, yì si shì “wǒ de míng zi shì Lǐ Míng”.
questions.explanation_translation: 我叫李明 is a common way to introduce a name; it means “My name is Li Ming.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个短语表示“很高兴认识你”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè duǎn yǔ biǎo shì hěn gāo xìng rèn shí nǐ
questions.prompt_translation: Which phrase means “Nice to meet you”?

options.pinyin: hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ

questions.explanation_learning: “很高兴认识你”常用于初次见面，表达认识对方很愉快。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ” cháng yòng yú chū cì jiàn miàn, biǎo dá rèn shi duì fāng hěn yú kuài.
questions.explanation_translation: 很高兴认识你 is used when meeting someone for the first time to say that you are pleased to meet them.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个汉字表示数字七？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè hàn zì biǎo shì shù zì qī
questions.prompt_translation: Which character is the number seven?
questions.explanation_learning: “七”表示数字 7，普通话读作 qī，使用第一声。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “qī” biǎo shì shù zì qī, pǔ tōng huà dú zuò qī, shǐ yòng dì yī shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: 七 means the number seven and is pronounced qī with the first tone.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“今天”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì jīn tiān
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “today”?
questions.explanation_learning: “今天”指说话当天，也就是 today。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “jīn tiān” zhǐ shuō huà dāng tiān.
questions.explanation_translation: 今天 refers to the current day, meaning “today.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示星期一？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì xīng qī yī
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means Monday?
questions.explanation_learning: “星期一”表示一周中的星期一，对应英语 Monday。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xīng qī yī” biǎo shì yì zhōu zhōng de xīng qī yī.
questions.explanation_translation: 星期一 is the first weekday in the standard Monday-to-Sunday naming sequence and means Monday.

questions.prompt_learning: 日期中的哪个汉字表示“月”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: rì qī zhōng de nǎ gè hàn zì biǎo shì yuè
questions.prompt_translation: Which character means “month” in a date?
questions.explanation_learning: “月”表示月份；日期表达中通常放在数字后面，例如“三月”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yuè” biǎo shì yuè fèn; zài yuè fèn biǎo dá zhōng tōng cháng fàng zài shù zì hòu miàn, lì rú “sān yuè”.
questions.explanation_translation: 月 means “month” and follows a number in a month expression, such as 三月 (March).

questions.prompt_learning: 中文日期通常按什么顺序排列？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zhōng wén rì qī tōng cháng àn shén me shùn xù pái liè
questions.prompt_translation: What is the usual Chinese date order?
questions.explanation_learning: 中文日期通常按从大到小的顺序排列：年、月、日。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zhōng wén rì qī tōng cháng àn cóng dà dào xiǎo de shùn xù pái liè: nián, yuè, rì.
questions.explanation_translation: Chinese dates normally follow a largest-to-smallest order: year, month, then day.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“明天”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì míng tiān
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “tomorrow”?
questions.explanation_learning: “明天”指今天之后的一天，也就是 tomorrow。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “míng tiān” zhǐ jīn tiān zhī hòu de yì tiān.
questions.explanation_translation: 明天 refers to the day after today, meaning “tomorrow.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个代词表示“我”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dài cí biǎo shì wǒ
questions.prompt_translation: Which pronoun means “I”?
questions.explanation_learning: “我”是第一人称单数代词，指说话的人自己。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ” shì dì yī rén chēng dān shù dài cí, zhǐ shuō huà de rén zì jǐ.
questions.explanation_translation: 我 is the first-person singular pronoun and refers to the speaker.

questions.prompt_learning: 表示女性“她”时通常写哪个汉字？
questions.prompt_pinyin: biǎo shì nǚ xìng tā shí tōng cháng xiě nǎ gè hàn zì
questions.prompt_translation: Which character is normally written for “she”?
questions.explanation_learning: “她”是书写中表示女性第三人称的汉字；它与“他”读音相同，都是 tā。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “tā” shì shū xiě zhōng biǎo shì nǚ xìng dì sān rén chēng de hàn zì; tā hé “他” dú yīn xiāng tóng.
questions.explanation_translation: 她 is the written third-person pronoun for a female. It is pronounced tā, the same as 他.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“我们”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì wǒ men
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “we”?
questions.explanation_learning: “我们”是第一人称复数，表示说话者和至少一位其他人。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ men” shì dì yī rén chēng fù shù, biǎo shì shuō huà zhě hé zhì shǎo yí wèi qí tā rén.
questions.explanation_translation: 我们 is the first-person plural pronoun, referring to the speaker and at least one other person.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我是学生”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ shì xué shēng
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “I am a student”?
questions.explanation_learning: “我是学生”由“我 + 是 + 学生”组成，意思是“I am a student”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ shì xué shēng” yóu “wǒ + shì + xué shēng” zǔ chéng, yì si shì “wǒ shì yí míng xué shēng”.
questions.explanation_translation: 我是学生 follows the pattern 我 + 是 + 学生 and means “I am a student.”

questions.prompt_learning: 在“我是学生”这样的句子中，哪个词用来说明身份？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài “wǒ shì xué shēng” zhè yàng de jù zi zhōng, nǎ ge cí yòng lái shuō míng shēn fèn?
questions.prompt_translation: Which word links a person to an identity, as in 我是学生?
questions.explanation_learning: 在这个句型中，“是”连接主语和身份或名词性说明，相当于英语中的 be。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zài zhè ge jù xíng zhōng, “shì” lián jiē zhǔ yǔ hé shēn fèn huò míng cí xìng shuō míng.
questions.explanation_translation: In this sentence pattern, 是 links the subject to an identity or noun phrase, similar to “be” in English.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“这是我的书”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì zhè shì wǒ de shū
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “This is my book”?
questions.explanation_learning: “这是我的书”中，“这”指 this，“是”连接说明，“我的”表示所属，“书”是物品。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zhè shì wǒ de shū” zhōng, “zhè” zhǐ this, “shì” lián jiē shuō míng, “wǒ de” biǎo shì suǒ shǔ, “shū” shì wù pǐn.
questions.explanation_translation: In 这是我的书, 这 means “this,” 是 links the description, 我的 marks possession, and 书 means “book.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个动词表示“吃”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dòng cí biǎo shì chī
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb means “to eat”?
questions.explanation_learning: “吃”表示进食，是常见的动作动词，例如“吃饭”和“吃水果”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “chī” biǎo shì jìn shí, shì cháng jiàn de dòng zuò dòng cí, lì rú “chī fàn” hé “chī shuǐ guǒ”.
questions.explanation_translation: 吃 means “to eat” and is a common action verb, as in 吃饭 and 吃水果.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个动词表示“喝”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dòng cí biǎo shì hē
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb means “to drink”?
questions.explanation_learning: “喝”表示饮用，后面通常接水、茶、咖啡等饮料。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “hē” biǎo shì yǐn yòng, hòu miàn tōng cháng jiē shuǐ, chá, kā fēi děng yǐn liào.
questions.explanation_translation: 喝 means “to drink” and is usually followed by a beverage such as water, tea or coffee.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个动词表示“去”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dòng cí biǎo shì qù
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb means “to go”?
questions.explanation_learning: “去”表示从当前位置前往某处，后面常接地点，例如“去学校”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “qù” biǎo shì cóng dāng qián wèi zhì qián wǎng mǒu chù, hòu miàn cháng jiē dì diǎn, lì rú “qù xué xiào”.
questions.explanation_translation: 去 means “to go” and is commonly followed by a destination, as in 去学校.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我喝水”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ hē shuǐ
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “I drink water”?
questions.explanation_learning: “我喝水”按“主语 + 动词 + 宾语”排列：我是主语，喝是动词，水是宾语。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ hē shuǐ” àn “zhǔ yǔ + dòng cí + bīn yǔ” pái liè: “wǒ” shì zhǔ yǔ, “hē” shì dòng cí, “shuǐ” shì bīn yǔ.
questions.explanation_translation: 我喝水 follows subject–verb–object order: 我 is the subject, 喝 the verb, and 水 the object.

questions.prompt_learning: 与书一起使用时，哪个动词可以表示“阅读”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: yǔ shū yī qǐ shǐ yòng shí nǎ gè dòng cí kě yǐ biǎo shì yuè dú
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb can mean “to read” when used with a book?
questions.explanation_learning: “看书”是常见搭配，表示阅读；“看”单独使用时也可以表示看见或观看。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “kàn shū” shì cháng jiàn dā pèi, biǎo shì yuè dú; “kàn” dān dú shǐ yòng shí yě kě yǐ biǎo shì kàn jiàn huò guān kàn.
questions.explanation_translation: 看书 is a common collocation meaning “to read.” 看 can also mean “to look at” or “to watch” in other contexts.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“学习”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì xué xí
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “to study” or “to learn”?
questions.explanation_learning: “学习”表示获取知识或练习技能，可以作动词使用，例如“学习中文”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xué xí” biǎo shì huò qǔ zhī shi huò liàn xí jì néng, kě yǐ zuò dòng cí shǐ yòng, lì rú “xué xí zhōng wén”.
questions.explanation_translation: 学习 means “to study” or “to learn” and can be used as a verb, as in 学习中文.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“学校”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì xué xiào
